text.tspan: The US is building gas pipelines to feed LNG exports
Gas pipelines in development to supply the growing US LNG export market, shown with
the specific LNG terminals they will serve and the broader operating pipeline network
Source: Global Energy Monitor, Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker, October 2026
Note: Includes four pipelines in construction (Blackcomb, Blackfin, Eiger Express and Pelican)
that will deliver gas to hubs that feed LNG plants and other buyers. Alaska LNG is not shown.
